critical_code_review_comments: CharacterSheet.jsx (lines 75-85, 127-138): quickRolls notation correctly uses '2d6+body|mind|soul|atk|def' and '1d6+mind' for Initiative; stat-tile onClick rolls `2d6+${s}` with the spec'd title 'Roll 2d6+body (BESM 4E: meet/beat the Target Number)'. Verified by intercepting POST /api/dice — payload contained "notation":"2d6+body". BESM 4E meet/beat semantics are correctly NOT subtracting the stat.

CharacterBuilder.jsx (line 86, 761-765): subtotal = cost_per_level × level, the spent useMemo and AttributeRow both omit Enh/Lim from cost. Effective Level = max(1, level + #limiters - #enhancements). The eff. badge (data-testid='attr-eff-level-builder-{idx}') is hidden when effDelta === 0. With level=1 and only 1 enhancement, effLevel floors back to 1 → badge hidden — this is mathematically correct, but the spec language 'when at least one Enhancement OR Limiter is selected' would technically expect a visible badge in that edge case. Adding 1 limiter (level=1+1=2) correctly makes the badge appear. Recommend either keeping current behaviour (no-op delta) or explicitly showing 'eff. ×1 (clamped)' for transparency.

CampaignDetail.jsx KnowledgeTab (lines 329-345, 548, 574-595): detailRef + useEffect → scrollIntoView on selectedNode change is correct; NodeDetail renders both `node.content` AND, when `node.fields[f.key]` is truthy, each template field via tmpl.fields.filter(...).map(...). Admin reset (routes/admin.py line 83) correctly copies `n.get('fields', {})` from seed_evereantha into Mongo, so structured fields are persisted on every reset.

routes/uploads.py: streaming-read with 1MB chunks + hard MAX_BYTES=12MB cap is memory-safe; cleanup unlink on overflow is in place; ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES whitelists png/jpeg/webp; GM/admin role gate is correct (player → 403). _sniff_dims uses Pillow defensively — falls back to (None,None) which the frontend already handles via natural dimensions.

seed_evereantha.EVEREANTHA_SESSIONS (~line 660+): 8 sessions, Session 2 chat logs include the Nyaulis 'You took from this wood.' line as required, Session 8 ends with the cliffhanger referencing Roney + the Mayor's note. Verified via GET /api/sessions/{sid}/chat against the live DB after reset.
